item.title: [LU-21125] kernel update [RHEL 8.10 4.18.0-553.182.1.el8_10]
item.description:
Security Fix(es) for kernel 4.18.0-553.182.1.el8_10:

  • Adding prod certs and changed cert date to 20210620 (Sherif Nagy)
  • Adding Rocky secure boot certs (Sherif Nagy)
  • Fixing vmlinuz removal (Sherif Nagy)
  • Fixing UEFI CA path (Sherif Nagy)
  • Porting to 8.10, debranding and Rocky branding (Louis Abel)
  • Fixing pesign_key_name values (Sherif Nagy)
  • ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period (Davide Caratti) [RHEL-295615] {CVE-2026-98432}
  • net: skbuff: propagate shared-frag marker in skb_zerocopy() (Xin Long) [RHEL-291583]
  • smb: client: bound dirent name against end of SMB response in cifs_filldir (Jorge San Emeterio Villalain) [RHEL-278321] {CVE-2026-93787}
  • scsi: target: core: Fix iSCSI ISID use-after-free in REGISTER AND MOVE (CKI Backport Bot) [RHEL-283491] {CVE-2026-72083}
  • tipc: require net admin for TIPCv2 netlink mutators (CKI Backport Bot) [RHEL-273171] {CVE-2026-74283}
  • ipv6: exthdrs: refresh nh pointer after ipv6_hop_jumbo() (Antoine Tenart) [RHEL-259350] {CVE-2026-63924}
  • ipv6: exthdrs: refresh nh after handling HAO option (Antoine Tenart) [RHEL-259375] {CVE-2026-63922}
  • af_unix: Fix peek then tail dereference UAF in unix_stream_data_wait() (Jamie Bainbridge) [RHEL-225873] {CVE-2026-64109}
  • KVM: arm64: vgic: Check the interrupt is still ours before migrating it (Mohammadfaiz Bawa) [RHEL-252475] {CVE-2026-72289}
  • KVM: arm64: vgic: Handle race between interrupt affinity change and LPI disabling (Mohammadfaiz Bawa) [RHEL-243811] {CVE-2026-72288}
  • scsi: target: iscsi: Reserve a terminator byte for the login payload (CKI Backport Bot) [RHEL-285567] {CVE-2026-90011}
  • KEYS: encrypted: fix integer overflow of datablob_len (Bruno Meneguele) [RHEL-279488] {CVE-2026-98222}
  • arp: do not assume dev_hard_header() does not change skb->head (Guillaume Nault) [RHEL-271136]
  • ip6_gre: make ip6gre_header() robust (Guillaume Nault) [RHEL-271136]
  • ipv4: ip_gre: make ipgre_header() robust (Guillaume Nault) [RHEL-271135]
  • KVM: s390: pci: Reject adapter interrupt forwarding if already enabled (CKI Backport Bot) [RHEL-277607] {CVE-2026-74515}
  • selinux: avoid sk_socket dereference in selinux_sctp_bind_connect() (Ondrej Mosnacek) [RHEL-243220] {CVE-2026-72242}
  • ipv4: validate checksum_start before completing checksum (Davide Caratti) [RHEL-280584] {CVE-2026-99999}
  • smb: client: clear setuid/setgid bit on write with cifsacl/modefromsid/posix extensions (Jorge San Emeterio Villalain) [RHEL-271260] {CVE-2026-89638}
  • mptcp: options: reset DSS fields in case of unexpected size (Prasenjit Mukherjee) [RHEL-250583] {CVE-2026-80586}
  • net/iucv: filter frames in afiucv_hs_rcv() by ingress device (CKI Backport Bot) [RHEL-270897] {CVE-2026-81003}
  • net/packet: avoid fanout hook re-registration after unregister (Jamie Bainbridge) [RHEL-246978] {CVE-2026-68338}
  • net/packet: fix a race in packet_set_ring() and packet_notifier() (Jamie Bainbridge) [RHEL-246978]

https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2026:93414

status.description: This issue is being actively worked on at the moment by the assignee.
